entities.summary: Ryan Michael Schimpf is an American former professional baseball infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres and Los Angeles Angels. He made his MLB debut in 2016 with the Padres and was named the National League's Rookie of the Month for July 2016.
